title: MEIKO — Because They're Important〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, this should be more than enough cake flour and coffee beans...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have everything I need, so I think I'll get started now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hiya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
MEIKO, are you making something?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome.
I was just thinking about baking a coffee pound cake.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't remember seeing that on the dessert menu. Wait, are you gonna add this to it...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Unfortunately, I won't be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's for Toya since he's been working so hard lately.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? For Toya?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. He came by the other day wondering what he should do about his song and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?! You're starting over from scratch?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... No matter how much I try, what I currently have just isn't shaping up to become anything good... So, I feel that starting over is a valid option.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, KAITO.
After all the help you've given me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, don't worry about that!
I'll also keep researching what I can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to also show my support by doing something for him...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I've decided to bake him a little treat that isn't too sweet using his favorite coffee beans.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so thoughtful of you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO, can we help you bake it?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna help Toya too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I also wanna help!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you both very much...
Then, let's all bake it together.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Be mindful of the temperature of the eggs and butter because the cake won't rise properly if they're not mixed well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Next, we'll start mixing our finely ground coffee beans into the batter.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay!
A little bit at a time and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna do that too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Rin, don't mix it too much.
Doing so will cause the batter to sink and the cake will become dense.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Got it!
Still, these coffee beans smell great...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they do. However, most of this aroma will be gone after it's finished baking. It'll just be a hint at the end...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which means only we get to experience this great smell!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, it's nicely baked...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Very nice work, you two.
Why don't we have some tea to celebrate?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, something smells nice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO! We just finished baking a coffee pound cake for Toya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You know how Toya's been working super hard lately? We decided to show our support by making him something he'd really like!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, this is for him?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was hoping to maybe have a little taste, but I guess I can't now that I know who it's for...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it must be good if you two baked it with MEIKO! I'm sure Toya is going to enjoy it very much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe.
KAITO, here's your slice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What? My slice...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
You've been helping Toya quite a lot lately, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, just the other day...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Is that KAITO? What's he doing here...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, this song has a bit of edge to it.
Toya could use this as a reference.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's not quite the same sort of energy he's trying to produce, but it's another idea to keep in mind...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You listened to all sorts of songs in hopes that you could give some good advice to Toya, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: H-How long were you watching me...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's a secret.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, this is a little reward for all your efforts. I'm glad you've been there for him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO... Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you're the one who's always there for us and the others!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think they like visiting SEKAI as often as they do because they know you're going to be here at the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, he's got a point!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The way you say, “Welcome,” whenever we walk in always feels so reassuring for some reason!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Exactly! So...
Thank you for everything!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're all very welcome.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's get that tea ready.
I'll pour some for you as well, KAITO, so just give me one minute.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay!
